name: Capture Browser Bridge
description: Connects web pages to the Capture Mac app for Inspect Mode element evidence and accessibility auditing.

capture-full-page-reverse.description: Capture full page (auto-scroll, vertical, bottom to top)

capture-full-page-horizontal-reverse.description: Capture full page (auto-scroll, horizontal, right to left)

capture-full-page-manual-start.description: Start manual scrolling capture (you control each scroll/snap)

capture-full-page-manual-snap.description: Manual scrolling capture: snap a tile at the current scroll position

capture-full-page-manual-finish.description: Manual scrolling capture: finish and stitch the collected tiles

capture-accessibility-audit.description: Run accessibility audit (heading outline, landmarks, images, links, forms)
